source_evidence: Any gains in the value of the index are generally calculated without including dividends paid on the securities that make up the index.
question: Misconception: An indexed annuity’s credited return automatically includes dividends paid by the securities in its market index.
answer: Correction: Indexed annuities generally calculate index gains without including dividends. So the return credited to the annuity may be based on less than the index’s total return; the contract’s terms determine how the return is calculated.
